Name: Binea, Son of Moza
Summary: Son of Moza, father of Rapha in the chapter 8 list.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:37; 1 Chronicles 9:43: Son of Moza, father of Rapha in the chapter 8 list.
